This file guides Claude Code. **CRITICAL**: This project uses **UV** for all Python operations. Never use `python -m`, `pip install`, or `python script.py` directly.
uv run pytest
uv run pytest tests/pm_agent/
uv pip install package
uv run python script.py
**⚠️ IMPORTANT**: The `.claude-plugin/` directory and TypeScript plugin system described in older docs **DO NOT EXIST** in v4.1.9. Planned v5.0 (issue #419).
Current architecture: Python package, slash commands; `src/superclaude/`, `tests/`, `scripts/`, `PLANNING.md`, `TASK.md`, `KNOWLEDGE.md`.
make dev
make verify
make test
uv run pytest tests/pm_agent/ -v
uv run pytest tests/test_file.py -v
uv run pytest -m confidence_check
uv run pytest --cov=superclaude
make lint
make format
make doctor
make build-plugin
make sync-plugin-repo
make clean
Registered via `pyproject.toml` entry point.
**Never guess** - verify with official docs (Context7 MCP, WebFetch, WebSearch) before implementation.
Check confidence BEFORE starting: ≥90% proceed, 70-89% present alternatives, <70% ask questions.
Use **Wave → Checkpoint → Wave** pattern.
**CRITICAL**: When running multiple Claude Code sessions in parallel, use `git worktree` to avoid conflicts.
pipx install superclaude
git clone https://github.com/SuperClaude-Org/SuperClaude_Framework.git
cd SuperClaude_Framework
**What Does NOT Work** (yet):
❌ `.claude-plugin/` directory auto-detection
❌ `/plugin marketplace add` commands
❌ `/plugin install superclaude`
❌ `make build-plugin` (planned but not functional)
❌ Project-local plugin detection
